name: acryl-door
description: The door of the app: an agent working in the app folder looks at the running page, acts on it (click, type, select, press, scroll, wait) and adds, removes or reloads plugins live, through .acryl/bin/acryl. Loopback only, a per-run secret in .acryl/door.json, an audit log and an in-page indicator with a stop button. Vendored from ACRYL.
mount: mount it after acryl-node-server and extensions in development builds: root.plugin(door); add <script type="module" src="/api/acryl-door/page.js"></script> to the pages; the command is .acryl/bin/acryl
